title: Creating the expected/ Directory
description: A loop that runs the interpreter on every test program and saves its output as the expected file for that test.

steps.description: The page says to run this once, after you are confident your interpreter produces the right output. `mkdir -p expected` creates the folder, and the loop visits every `tests/*.ml` file.
`name=$(basename "$f" .ml)` strips the directory prefix and the `.ml` suffix, so `tests/fibonacci.ml` becomes `fibonacci`.
The interpreter runs on each file, and `> "expected/${name}.txt" 2>&1` redirects both stdout and stderr into the expected file for that test.
